purpose: Desktop web application for building road networks and running agent-based traffic simulations in Three.js

coordinates.unit: World unit = 1/4 road tile (one City Kit Roads tile scaled ×4 = 4 units). Real-world metres not yet assigned.
coordinates.forwardAxis: +Z for vehicles (Car Kit front wheels at +Z). City Kit road-straight runs along X in source; rotated 90° about Y to run along Z.
coordinates.originPolicy: Car Kit: origin at ground centre of vehicle. City Kit Roads: origin at tile centre, surface at y=0.02 (source units). App keeps source origins and places by transform.
coordinates.conversionPolicy: Inspect source units and axes, confirm the application's conventions, and record conversions before applying them.

deliveryFormats: GLB with external PNG texture (Textures/colormap.png beside each model)
externalDependencies: public/models/roads/Textures/colormap.png (City Kit Roads; different file, same name)

roadPieces.placementPreview: Use a translucent preview with the same position, rotation, elevation, snapping, and validity checks as the final placement.
roadPieces.gradeSeparation: Roads at different heights connect through an explicit link, such as a ramp.

commands.browserCheck: npm run verify:browser  # requires dev server; or node scripts/verify-browser.mjs <url>
commands.browserCheckHeaded: npm run verify:browser:headed  # same check in a visible Chrome window

verification.initialBrowserCheck: Load one supplied vehicle on a short road section with a supplied road texture. Inspect the scene, browser errors, and asset requests before marking setup verified.
